notes.title: July Update
notes.notes:
This update has a word count of 164,364 words of content.

The following content is effective as of this release. For ease of reference, they are listed according to the in-game timeline.

I. Plot and Unlocking Adjustments

At the end of Chapter 8

The ending prompt has been changed to “Niechi Tsom's favorability interface has been unlocked”, and then you will go directly to Chapter 9.



Chapter 9

Advance to mainline.

New Year's branch

Chivalrous character branch (Xia Cheng, Qu Lan Jing, Shangguan Ling branch I)

Small short character branch after possessing the Water Mirror

Nie Chichol Tsoem branch (Choose to accept his jade pendant in Chapter 8)



Enter the second year after Chapter 9

Unlock the Jingling favor interface.

Open the new area “Xuan Shan Pass”.

Obtain the item “Passage Ultimatum”.



During the free activity period

Xuan Shan Pass can trigger Jing Ling's first meeting and interaction.

New item - “Water Mirror” function can check the character's current thoughts.

After August 1, the new thread “Hate in the Old Times” will be triggered at the guardhouse from 9:00am to 6:00pm on weekdays.

After September 1, the new thread “Buddha of the Mud Puddle” will be triggered at the guardhouse from 9:00am to 6:00pm on weekdays.

Outdoor Mansion - Nights New co-sleeping feature added to the room (pure black avatar characters do not have this feature)



February of the second year

Enter Chapter 10 (You can bring your teammates to trigger the episode. It is recommended to archive the ending)



March 16, 2012

Started “Time Stop Mode”, the date will not be incremented anymore; the automatic reset related to the date change will be invalidated (this kind of situation is not counted as a bug).



System and function updates

Cooking: support filtering recipes by flavor.

Flower Field/Farming Field: Keyboard operation is supported.

Some items (e.g. Mystery Pill, Reverse Pill) can be used in bulk.

Love Gift: Gift list can be filtered by type.

Pharmaceutical System: Read “Hundred Medicines Recipe - Up” to unlock pharmaceuticals, and add a variety of new functional elixirs.

New mounts: Elixirs of the highest level pharmaceutical recipes will be given to those who achieve the “Successor of Shennong” achievement after successfully crafting each of them once.

2025/5/7 – Update Log:expanded Si Fangjue's affection side story.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just pushed a new game update, which mainly includes new romance character dialogues and additional content for Si Fangjue’s affection side story. We've also fixed several bugs that may have affected your gameplay experience~

Due to Steam's update delay, some players may not see the update prompt immediately. If you enter the game without updating, there is a high chance of encountering in-game errors. To avoid affecting your gameplay, we recommend restarting Steam and launching the game again.

Latest Version: 18370894

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/51560158fd86e3dc7ab76e5922e1f4840c3528b5.png

【New Content】

 Added post-affection dialogue for romance characters at the Courtyard.
※ These may trigger randomly when choosing “Chat with them” while interacting with companions in the Courtyard.
 Added new reactions from romance and certain bond characters to the player's updated "status".
 Added additional side story for Si Fangjue after deepening affection:
The first time you visit the Sect Leader's Office after developing feelings with Si Fangjue, the new storyline will trigger.


【Bug Fixes】

 Fixed an issue where Jiang Yuanyi’s Personal Route I could not be reviewed in the Exhibition Room.
 Fixed facial sprite inconsistencies in Shi Cang’s dialogue on the Undersea Map.
 Fixed mismatch between bubble reminders and unlock timing in Zhihan's redemption side quest.
 Fixed an issue where feeding cats at the lakeside was possible even if no cats appeared after gifting an extra fish in "Fortune Favors the Bold".
 Fixed missing Fresh Meat Mooncake under the Food category in the inventory.
 Fixed a bug in the Jinse bad ending where Yan Ge wouldn’t ask the player to leave, preventing progression.
 Fixed an issue where quick save retained the last memo note after using the save note function.
 Fixed an issue where teasing Ah Hui could indefinitely increase favorability.
 Fixed a black screen after returning from vacation.
 Fixed an issue where Chang Kongming became non-interactable after triggering a new reaction dialogue.


Lastly, here are some helpful reminders about how to trigger the new dialogues and side content:

Post-Affection Courtyard Dialogue:
Team up with your romance character and visit the Courtyard to trigger this content.
There are two branching versions depending on whether the Courtyard is unoccupied or has multiple residents.

New Status & Companion Reactions:
The multiple-resident Courtyard event will cause a certain romance character to become jealous, granting you a new status.
This status lasts for three days and will trigger special NPC reaction dialogues during that time.

Si Fangjue Affection Side Story Trigger Conditions:
After developing affection with Si Fangjue, visiting the Sect Leader’s Office for the first time will trigger this story.
It offers further insight into the Sect Leader’s feelings.

Note:
[olist]
 The requirements for the exclusive ending (loyalty route) are unrelated to the Courtyard.
This update focuses solely on Courtyard-related content, which is why Courtyard residents are involved.
 If Zhihan is taken away by another romance route character, future updates will include side stories that may allow them to move into your Courtyard later.
[/olist]

notes.notes:
--[Update cycle for major releases
The update cycle for subsequent major releases is roughly three months. The most recent major version update was: three months from April 15, 2025 counting.
We'll end up with new mainline content, with miscellaneous branching threads. The prognosis is two chapters of mainline and some jumbled stuff at a time.

--[Content of the major update
The current mainline is mainly running on the theme of 'usurping the throne'. Later on, the main thread will branch out more and lead to a completely different ending.
Later on, we'll end up with teammate interactions of certain raid targets, and the outer courtyard co-sleeping that people are very interested in (note: all-ages oriented ha!) The Raider Route.
Raiding routes for certain chivalrous fates will also be gradually advanced.
Optimizing dialogue + dating for raid targets is also on the cards.
Lest this pie doesn't feed the hunger, I'll be dropping some development content from time to time afterward, as I've done in the past. There's also the little essay session that everyone enjoys.

--[Bug Fix Issues
The current version is more stable now. Subsequent bug fixes, unless they are very urgent, will be saved up a bit more before being fixed. The cycle will be roughly around three days to a week.

--[Minor Updates (Pie)
Minor update drops, on the other hand, are irregular, and I may somehow drop some minor updates (?). . But our main focus will be on the big updates, and we've planned out that there's quite a bit of content left over.
[This is a pie, not sure it will definitely drop. Don't get your hopes up too high.] ↑

-- [Secondary sales of peripherals
Considering the game's tight development cycle, I'll prioritize keeping the project moving forward. Therefore, there shouldn't be any new types of peripherals for secondary vendors, and I'll try to choose peripherals that have been done before.
[Customization type options will be ban by me, I really can't finish drawing. With this kind of time, you can wish me to write a few more spinoffs (not)]
Adults can fill out a questionnaire to tell you what you want from the periphery. Even if we don't do it this time, we'll refer to this questionnaire's poll afterward.
I'm not quite sure what people want. In addition to giveaway related, game content related can also be wished for.
[I'll read the opinions of the adults carefully, but I'll also consider the possibility of realizing them. Anyway, I'll use your opinions as a reference! There's no guarantee that it'll come true. (Habitual Armor Stacking)

--[Amount of Text]
I haven't counted how much text there is. Actually 150w was the previous count, and we already had 170w when we first went live.
After that, we'll be piling on the details and differentials where they're not useful.
--
Only writing about what we have planned so far. I can't just paint a picture, it needs to be done. The rest of the stuff will come slowly, so please don't be in a hurry.
We'll keep to the plan and stay on track!

notes.title: 2025/4/14 Update Log (New Branch & New Plot)
notes.notes:
Good evening, players!
We just pushed a new update. Aside from bug fixes, the main focus is on new story content, including character side stories for Zhusha, Shi Cang, and Jiang Yuanyi.

【Fixes】

 Fixed a bug where choosing to spend the night with Nie Chicuomu didn’t correctly set the related variable.
 Fixed an issue where Nie Chicuomu’s Bad Ending “Maybe Hopeless Romantics Should Be on Healthcare” couldn’t be triggered.
 Fixed the interaction menu bug in Xing Lan’s room where right-click wouldn’t allow players to exit.
 Fixed the missing “kick out” event in Xiao Weizhi’s room.
 Fixed abnormal lag when moving around the map after extended play sessions.
 Fixed an issue where interactions with Sifang Jue and Meng Qinglan wouldn’t trigger.
 Fixed a bug that prevented Meng Qinglan’s sparring event from starting.
 Reinforced time restrictions for all festival venues.
 Added text descriptions for special items in Chapters 6 and 7 of the main story.
 Cleaned up Zhusha’s ending logic and patched missing text.

【New Content】

 Added a new Breakthrough Side Story (triggered at Level 85; required item info can be found in the previous update).
 Added Zhusha Side Story – “What I Can Do.”
 Added Jiang Yuanyi Side Story – “Do You Not Know?”
 Added Shi Cang Side Story – “Leaving the Water.”
 Added new backyard training responses from teammates.
 Added random dramatic events during stall gameplay.

Here are some trigger conditions for the newly added side stories:

 Breakthrough Side Story: Player must be level 85+, and find Qi Yang Xixin to trigger.
 Zhusha Side Story: After completing the first two parts of Zhusha’s story and reaching 80+ intimacy, visit the Guard Station during daytime. We highly recommend players who activated the yuri switch to replay the related side stories.
 Shi Cang Side Story: 80+ intimacy, Shi Cang story triggered twice (requires visiting Shi Cang’s underwater room), Shi Cang must be by the sea [on the surface], and player must possess the Water-Repelling Pearl.
 Jiang Yuanyi Side Story: In May, with 2000 merit points, 500 reputation, visit the Office at midnight, and 50+ intimacy with Jiang Yuanyi.
Note: We've restructured the logic for Zhusha and Shi Cang’s side stories, so you may encounter repeated triggers. We apologize in advance!

P.S. If your companions or cats disappear, please refresh the map once. To resolve lag issues, teammates are now cleared upon game launch, which may affect their in-map presence.

Due to possible delays in the Steam update process, to prevent crashes or errors and preserve your experience, we recommend checking the build number to ensure you're on the latest version.
Check your build number via: [Library] → [Trickster Gods] → [Properties] → Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/b667cefbb46ab89f5d51e94cea5b79dd24a281ed.png
Current build number: 18100818

If you encounter any other issues after the update, please submit them via our BUG Report Form.
Thank you again for your patience and support for our humble dev team! 💖
